assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a transparent chibi subagent avatar for Umeko Desktop.
Draw Kazuhiko Nukumizu / 温水和彦, the MALE protagonist of Makeine. Image 1 and 2 are his official character identity/costume references. Image 3 is ONLY the application's crisp chibi rendering style; do not borrow its female character identity, thick eyebrows or uniform.
Identity: ordinary-looking introverted teenage boy, short slightly tousled charcoal/dark-brown hair with asymmetrical separated front bangs and a little loose crown tuft, warm gray-brown eyes, normal fairly thin dark brows, fair skin. White school shirt with a neatly folded collar and a plain straight grass-green NECKTIE (not a bow). No glasses, no jewelry or makeup.
A compact head-and-collar portrait, gently deadpan but kind, small restrained closed-mouth smile, relaxed slightly wry expression. Preserve a recognizable boyish face and subdued eyes rather than a generic very round cute girl face. Complete hair silhouette with comfortable 5% transparent margin; include shirt collar and the top of the green tie. Face should remain readable at 40px.
Match the polished clean fine dark outlines and pixel-edged anime cel shading of image 3, muted natural highlights, simple bold shapes. ONE centered character on square truly transparent canvas. No circular frame, scenery, hands, props, text, watermark or logo.

assets.motif: Waist-up, relaxed quiet smile, one hand touching his cheek in thoughtful conversation, other arm resting naturally. Preserve plain green tie and white short-sleeved shirt; no blazer.
